title: Declaration 18.10 and estimatr 2.0
published: Declaration 18.10 calls `declare_estimator()` without `se_type`, and declares the periods level with `add_level(nest = FALSE)` and `by = join_using(units, periods)`.
corrected: NA
note:
On pgs. 284-285, Declaration 18.10 now writes `se_type = "CR2"` in its `declare_estimator()` call. Under estimatr 1.x, a fit with both `fixed_effects` and `clusters` used CR2 standard errors by default, so this is the estimator the printed book ran; estimatr 2.0 changed that default to CR0 and warns when the choice is left implicit. Naming CR2 keeps the diagnosis as printed and removes the warning. The periods level is now declared with `declare_level()` and joined with `cross_levels(.by = c("units", "periods"))`, the fabricatr 2.0 form of `add_level(nest = FALSE)` and `by = join_using(units, periods)`; the data drawn are the same.

Class note: class wording, for the reason given at entry 18.
